description: What is new, changed or retracted since a time or cursor. Use it to answer what moved since I last looked. The feed follows our capture order, not publishedAt, so an older document can appear after a newer one: that is correct, do not re-sort. Pass nextCursor back unchanged while hasMore is true. Cost: 1 credit.

changeKind.description: Kinds of change to include. Omit for all.

cursor.description: Opaque. Pass back exactly the nextCursor of the previous page. Do not parse, edit or construct one.

docType.description: Document types as returned in results. A list of separate values.

limit.description: Page size, 1 to 100. Omit to use the default.

publisherId.description: Publisher ids, e.g. ['sebi', 'rbi']. A list of separate values, never one comma-joined string.

since.description: ISO date or timestamp. Omit to continue from a cursor.

sourceId.description: Source ids (a publisher's sub-sources, as get_regulatory_coverage lists them). A list of separate values, never comma-joined.

name: list_regulatory_changes
